item.title: University of Guelph and Xanadu Sign MOU to Advance Quantum Education and Talent Development
item.summary: The University of Guelph (U of G) and photonic quantum computing developer Xanadu Quantum Technologies (NASDAQ/TSX: XNDU) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to collaborate on quantum computing education, curriculum integration, and workforce development.
